Attention Pilots,
Mecha BREAK will undergo scheduled maintenance starting November 24 at 12:00 (UTC+8). Login and gameplay will be unavailable during maintenance. Estimated downtime: 6 hours (subject to change—check official announcements for updates). Upon completion, all Pilots who log in within 14 days of maintenance will receive a routine maintenance package via mail (1,000 Mission Tokens, not counted toward seasonal accumulation).
Below are the main changes in this update:

**New MOD Striker HURRICANE · Black Mamba Now Available**
Shield up. Close in. Strike without warning. HURRICANE · Black Mamba will be available following the update.

**1. How to Obtain**
(1) How to Participate: Pilots can access [Targeted Supply] from the [Shop] and use [Targeted Supply Keys] or [Corite] to draw rewards.
(2) Supply Rewards: Rewards include Mod Parts and Aux Kits for [HURRICANE · Black Mamba], HURRICANE-exclusive Striker Designs, Mod Kits, Modular Weapons, Aux Enhancement Modules, Gliders and Glider Aux, HURRICANE-exclusive paints, and currency exchange items.

**(3) Targeted Supply Rules**
**Costs**
• Each draw costs 1 [Targeted Supply Key].
• If you do not have enough keys, you can cover the shortfall with [Corite] at a rate of 50 [Corite] per [Targeted Supply Key].

**Obtaining Mod Parts**
• Each draw has a chance to award 1 of the 6 Mod Parts for [HURRICANE · Black Mamba].
• Obtain a new Mod Part in no more than 30 draws, with no duplicates. Each Mod Part you receive resets the draw counter.
• Once you have collected all 6 Mod Parts, Mod Parts will no longer drop. All other rewards will continue to drop as usual.

**Obtaining HURRICANE-Exclusive Striker Designs**
• Draws from [HURRICANE · Black Mamba] Targeted Supply have a chance to award the exclusive Striker Designs [HURRICANE · Frsot Raid] and [HURRICANE · Gilded Rift].
• You are guaranteed 1 HURRICANE-exclusive Striker Design within 60 draws.
• Each exclusive Striker Design can only be obtained once.
(4) Collection Rewards: Collect all 6 Mod Parts and unlock the modified stats to receive the exclusive [Black Mamba] title and [HURRICANE · Black Mamba] Striker Design as bonus rewards.

**2. How to Use**
**(1) How to Use Mod Parts**
• Once you obtain a Mod Part, click it to use it directly. You can also use Mod Parts from your Inventory or via [Striker Bay] > [Striker Design] >
